title: Incheon Airport To Seoul: Choose Your Best Ride
summary: Choose the best way from Incheon Airport to Seoul based on where you’re staying. Compare the trains, airport buses and official taxis.

slides.title: Match The Ride To Your Hotel
slides.sub: Choose the drop-off closest to your stay
slides.voice: Incheon to Seoul? Choose the ride that drops you closest.

slides.title: Train For Your Hotel
slides.voice: Seoul Station? Express, with assigned seats. Hongdae or Gongdeok? All-Stop, paid with a transit card.
slides.photo_query: AREX Express train Seoul Incheon Airport

slides.title: Skip The Stairs
slides.sub: Check buses for Myeongdong, Gangnam or Jamsil
slides.voice: Myeongdong, Gangnam or Jamsil? Check airport buses; many stop near big hotels. Allow extra time for traffic.
slides.photo_query: Incheon Airport limousine bus Seoul Korea

slides.title: For Late Or Luggage
slides.sub: Use the official taxi rank outside arrivals
slides.voice: Late, in a group, or loaded with bags? Use the official taxi rank. Landing after ten-thirty? Check your terminal’s last train.
